title: NoMechanics
description: Lightweight server plugin that completely disables all redstone mechanics, pistons, hoppers, and automation systems for vanilla survival gameplay.
body:
# NoMechanics

A lightweight server-side plugin for Paper/Spigot that completely disables all mechanical systems in Minecraft.

## 🚫 What Gets Blocked

### Redstone Components
- Redstone dust, blocks, and torches
- Repeaters and comparators
- Redstone lamps
